1.o: While recruiting for the basketball club, the Seirin Private High school has managed to pick up some impressive players; a power house, former American player, and a member of the “Generation of Miracles.

2.o: Before anyone can become an official member of the Basketball Club, they first must do display courage. Afterwards, a surprising guest appears on the school grounds with a shocking offer.

3.t: It's Better If I Can't Win
3.o: Seirin basketball club is playing a practice game at Kaijo High School, the school where Kise attends. After a display of power from Kagami, it forces the Kaijo coach to take Seirin serious.

4.t: Take Care of the Counter Attack!
4.o: The only way to stop Kise is to challenge him with a style he can't copy, Kurokos! The new offensive from Seirin is closing the point gap, until an injury might derail Serin's chance at victory.

5.o: Serin is victorious against Kaijo, barely.  It is a shock to Kise, who has never lost in his life. After the game, another former Teiko Middle school player, Midorima, has a few words for Kise.

6.t: Let Me Tell You Two Things
6.o: Serins first opponent in the inter-high tournament is Shinkyo high, a middle tier school until last year.  With the addition of a two meter tall, 87 kilogram player from Senegal, Shinkyo is a new threat to Serins championship hopes.

7.o: After their win over Shinkyo, Seirin goes on to crush their next few opponents. Realizing too much confidence is brewing, the team is taken to watch a Shutoku match. After seeing how Shutoku, one of the three Emperor teams of basketball, dominates their opposition, the team realizes they have a long way to go if they are to improve and contend for the title.

8.t: Now That I Think About It
8.o: Seirin takes on Seiho, a squad built around an invincible defense. The unorthodox manner in the way Seiko moves is finally understood, but it may be too late. Will Seirin's streak finally be shutdown?

9.o: Seirin's game continues against Seiho with neither team giving up points.  Kuroko and Kagami are pulled after the first quarter, to preserve their strength. Can their team mates bring home the victory?

10.o: Kuroko has rejoined the game in the final moments, but it seems that one of the players has him figured out. Seirin is playing hard, but if they win, will they have the strength to play a 2nd game

11.o: Seirin is holding their own against Shutoku, but in the 2nd half Midorima and Takao’s abilities are unleashed, shutting down Seirin’s game completely

12.o: The pressure of the game is causing Kagami skills to rapidly increase; he continues to score keeping Seirin in the game. But his thoughts are turning darker and self-serving

13.o: With only 10 minutes left, Seirin is in trouble.  Kagami has run out of gas and Midorima shows no sign of stopping.  Kuroko is back in the game with a new, but dangerous pass.

14.o: After an awkward dinner involving rival basketball teams, Kuroko happens upon a dog that looks just like him. The dog quickly gathered favor with everybody except for one.

15.o: Kuroko explains part of the history of the "Generation of Miracle" to Kagami.

16.o: Even without Aomine, Touou Academy is dominating against Seirin.  It is an uphill battle against Touou Academy individual style of play and the genius of Satsuki.

17.o: In a few minutes of play, Aomie has demonstrated why he is a force to be reckoned with, with Kuroko benched in the 2nd half, will the team be able to hold Aomie off?

18.o: Aomie is unstoppable, but Serin hasn't given up yet. But with Kagami pulled in the last few minutes, can the team play without him?

19.o: The only thing you can do is pick yourself up and move on. Some can move on faster, while others wallow in their own darkness. A new beginning and an old friend is what needed to pick the team back up.

20.o: Kiyoshi has a plan for Kuroko and Kagami to get them over their slump. Kuroko, on the other hand, think he needs to be pulled.

21.o: The training camp from hell has begun.

22.t: I'll Win Even If It Kills Me
22.o: The training camp is over and everyone has learned something about themselves. But the team is not ready to leave yet, as there is a game happening: Kaijo vs Touou, Kise Ryota vs Aomine Daiki.

23.o: Kise copy technique has lead Kaijo to take the early lead. With Touou keeping pace, Aomine is enjoying the pressure and is getting better each minute.

24.o: Touou Academy has not stolen the game like expected. If they can’t break away, Kise will finally reach full potential.

25.o: The game has reached a fever pitch and some of the players are about to break. Can Kise keep up copy of Aomine or will Aomine finally be able to go all out.

1.t: I Never Thought We'd Meet Here
1.o: Seirin's first years participate in a street basketball tournament where they meet Tatsuya Himuro and Atsushi Murasakibara from Yōsen High.

2.o: The street ball game gets called off due to heavy rain. Meanwhile, Momoi reveals that Aomine did not play in the Inter-High finals due to injuries that led her to request the coach to drop him to the bench. She also revealed the reasons why Murasakibara and Seijūrō Akashi from Rakuzan High, did not play as well. Later on, Kuroko shows Momoi his newest technique which if it is refined well, no one can ever stop him.

This marks the official return for center, 'Iron Heart' Kiyoshi Teppei since recovering from his leg injury. Although Kagami gets less involved due to him being double teamed, with Kiyoshi's unpredictable play and rebounds being the main focuses, Seirin gets even better in terms of offense and defense. Seirin takes control of the whole match, winning it by the score of 108-61. However, the next few qualifying matches might just get tougher for Seirin.

Outside the locker room, Kagami overheard the fiery conversation between Hyuga and Kiyoshi and then at night, he asked Hyuga more about it. It was actually Kiyoshi's final chance of playing high school basketball, despite only being in his 2nd year. 8.t: We're the Seirin High School Basketball Team!
8.o: Hyuga officially joins the basketball team, and so does Riko. They win their first matches and entered the final match against Kirisaki Daiichi and Hanamiya Makoto, a Crownless General like Kiyoshi. In one of the last plays Hanamiya purposely injures Kiyoshi's leg. Seirin lose the subsequent matches and are eliminated from the Nationals. Hyuga is determined to lead the team next year to be the best in Japan, which currently they are on course to be, and Kirisaki Daiichi is next in Seirin's way.

9.o: Up next is Seirin against Kirisaki Daiichi. As usual, Kirisaki Daiichi plays dirty, on offense and defense, trying to injure the opposing players. However, Kiyoshi still pushes on and gets his spirit really burned up, but while he's fired up Hyuga can't seem make any of his 3-pointers. Will Seirin get over this extremely rough matchup?

10.o: Seirin leads by 5 points going into the 2nd half, and Kirisaki Daiichi executes their trap, in which Hanamiya gets his steals with 100% accuracy, and Seirin just has fallen under this trap. Kuroko suggests the team to take a gamble of trust in each other in order to break free of this trap. Will Seirin get their ticket to the Winter Cup?

11.o: Seirin managed to break free of Kirisaki Daiichi's 'spider web'. However, the game is still not over with Hanamiya having another card up his sleeves. Will Seirin still get their berth at the Winter Cup or is it over for them?

12.o: After the winter cup prelimenaries, Seirin had their rest at a hotspring. At the same time, Tōō Academy is there, it's a surprise for them that they will fight in the first round. Will Seirin be nervous or they will be filled with excitement?

13.o: Before the Winter Cup starts, Akashi summons the rest of the Generation of Miracles, along with Kuroko. Kagami also joins in and it is a bad first meeting between Akashi and Kagami. The highly anticipated match between Seirin and Tōō Academy starts, and who will take the advantage?

14.o: Seirin managed to keep on pace with Tōō Academy. However, things just don't go right when Kuroko has both his moves being stopped consecutively by Aomine. How will Seirin come back to the game?

15.o: Kagami managed to hold Aomine and put Seirin close to Tōō Academy. Only down by 2, Seirin seemed to be able to keep in pace. However, another crisis would soon happen. How will this hinder Seirin's chances of winning the rematch?

16.o: Imayoshi is able to immobilise Kuroko, and Sakurai manages to stop Hyuga's Barrier Jumper, both actions being instructed by Momoi. Aomine goes past Kagami and makes a 360 spin dunk at the same time. All 5 Touou players are now able to see Kuroko. However, this actually leads to a trap set by Kuroko, when Izuki goes past Imayoshi with a Vanishing Drive, something the crowd thought only Kuroko can pull off, and scores. After slowing getting back into the game, Seirin suddenly could not stop the Aomine who has entered the Zone. However, Kagami has managed to stop Aomine and what will the battle of the aces be like?

18.o: An intense battle between the Aces of their teams, Aomine and Kagami, begins. Both never give in to each other and blocked the shots of each other. The other players on the court are very amazed at the battle of the Aces in the Zone, which makes their focus and reaction speed to be at their maximums. Kagami goes to drive past Aomine and scores a basket, to cut Tōō's lead to just 3, 95-98, with 41.5 seconds left. In the next possession for Tōō, Aomine found it difficult to drive past Kagami, but he quickly goes for a Formless Shot.

19.o: After the tough and close win over Tōō, the Seirin team decides to find a place to rest and rejuvenate. With no places to go due to various reasons, Kagami offers the team an invitation to his house. After a restful night for the team, they find Alexander Garcia, Kagami's master in basketball, sleeping in Kagami's house. The Seirin team, along with Alex, went to watch the Winter Cup match between Onita and Shutoku, with the latter taking the win easily, and Midorima caught Alex's attention.

20.o: While the match between Seirin and Nakamiya South progresses, at Touou Academy's library, Imayoshi and Susa discussed about Seirin's possibility of winning the match while studying. Seirin indeed are in a difficult situation of beating Nakamiya South. Imayoshi said that Seirin have not given their 120% like what the players did against Touou, and they may have gotten a little overconfident as they have defeated Tōō.

21.o: Still unable to score against Murasakibara and the Yōsen team, Seirin resorted to Kuroko taking shots, and they are back on track in the game. However, Himuro has not played his ball yet, so will Seirin be prepared for it?

22.o: Aomine thinks that Himuro is good, although the latter had never appeared in a tournament in Japan. Back to the match, Himuro executes a superb fake on Kagami, then smoothly transitions to take a jump shot, to which Kagami and Hyuga cannot react to it. Before the match, Himuro said to Murasakibara that he wants to crush Kagami, and that being brothers with him is getting in his way to be the better basketball player.

23.o: With Murasakibara finally appearing on the offensive side, Seirin is slowly losing hope of having the chance to win against Yōsen and move onto the Finals. With the help of the Vice-captain, Fukui, Murasakibara catches the ball and dunks it, causing the hoop to break and collide with the ground, even further diminishing the hope of Seirin.

24.o: As the match continues in the fourth quarter, Yōsen keeps on maintaining its lead and with Kiyoshi out, the Seirin players face tough times scoring any points. Seirin starts to use the same full court 2-3 man-to-man defense like what Yosen uses, but Himuro and Murasakibara are easily able to overcome it. However, Kagami's spirit to win gets him into the Zone once again.After some time in the Zone, Seirin cuts down the lead to four points.

25.o: In the last minute of the fourth quarter, Murasakibara enters the Zone. However, Kagami had so much spirit to win that he exceeded his limits and used meteor jam, his new shot that he can use only in the Zone. He jammed the ball in, scoring the final point. However, Atsushi still had determination and went for his shot. However, Murasakibara could not jump and Kuroko blocked his shot, handing victory over to Seirin. However, on the day of the semi-finals, Kuroko and Kagami both realized their basketball shoes were broken and hurriedly get on their way to buy new shoes. However, Kagami can't find shoes in his size! Thanks to Kuroko's suggestion, they seek advice from Momoi, and her reply is that he should use Aomine's shoes, as they both have the same shoe size. 6.o: Facing Akashi's Emperor Eye, which sees the future movements of the opponents, Shutoku looks like they had no hand to play. But the will to fight once again lights up within the eyes of the team members, and they face Rakuzan with the spirit of "unyielding tenacity"! Thanks to Midorima and Takao's trick play, they try to close the gap in one strong run, but to answer that, Akashi scores in his own goal to the shock of everyone around him. Kise, Kagami and Kuroko did have some short greetings before their match. The match started, how can Seirin stop Kise's Perfect Copy?

As the last one to awaken, and one with potential comparable to the Generation of Miracles, Kagami was on his way to unleashing that latent talent. Kise felt that as a threat more than anyone else. That was why he definitely didn't want to lose!!

Kagami's talents give way to Seirin having a 15-point gap in the lead with four minutes left in the game. Kise's frustration leads him to recover fast, determined to win the cup. Rico is surprised and realizes that Kise's Perfect Copy can now last until the end of the competition.

11.o: Kise recovers and manages to fill the 15-point gap. Kaijo becomes the lead with a score of 78-77. Seirin becomes restless and their moves become stiff as Kise's fast recovery and Kaijo's persistence to win makes the crowds cheer, putting Seirin under pressure. Kuroko devises a plan that requires time for observation in order to overcome Kise's Perfect Copy.

1.o: Shinji Ikari is summoned to Tokyo-3 by his estranged father Gendo, commander of the special agency NERV, to defend the city from a giant Angel by piloting the only weapon capable of battling the monster: Evangelion Unit-01.

2.o: Shinji wakes up in the hospital, with no memory of defeating the Angel the night before. Rejected by his father, Misato decides to take Shinji with her to live in her apartment. Later that night, memories of the battle against the Angel come flooding back to Shinji.

3.o: Shinji begins attending his new school in Tokyo-3, and has a difficult time dealing with the fame of being an Evangelion pilot. Touji Suzuhara, who's little sister was injured in Shinji's fight against the Angel, is angry at Shinji. A new Angel appears, and Shinji must once again pilot EVA-01 to defeat it.

4.o: Misato is upset with Shinji for ignoring her orders in the last Angel battle, and he is so overcome by the stress of being an EVA pilot that he runs away. After wandering around Tokyo-3 for several days, Shinji is faced with the choice of quitting or staying in his new home.

5.o: EVA-00 is finally repaired, and Shinji tries to get to know its enigmatic pilot, Rei Ayanami, better. However, he is confounded because she is extremely insular, has no friends at all, and the entire record of her past has been erased. In the midst of this, a very powerful Angel, the floating monolith Ramiel, attacks Tokyo-3.

6.o: Continuing from the previous episode, the Angel Ramiel is drilling down into the GeoFront to attack NERV HQ directly. After Shinji barely survived a direct confrontation with it, Misato devises a plan to have EVA-00 and EVA-01 defeat the Angel by sniping it from a distance using a positronic rifle which requires the total electric output of Japan to power up.

7.o: Ritsuko briefs Shinji on the real nature of Second Impact, the Angels, and the Evangelions' mission to defeat them. Misato and Ritsuko attend the public demonstration of a new Angel-fighting robot, Jet Alone, built by a rival defense contractor to NERV. However, the nuclear-powered robot quickly runs out of control, and Shinji must use EVA Unit 01 to load Misato onto Jet Alone so she can she can enter in its automatic shutdown code, before it melts down in a nuclear explosion.

8.o: Misato brings Shinji, along with Touji and Kensuke, to a massive UN naval convoy transporting Evangelion Unit-02 and its fiery German pilot, Asuka Langley Souryuu, to Japan. Escorting Asuka is Misato's old boyfriend, Ryouji Kaji. After some awkward introductions and reunions, the fleet is attacked by a massive aquatic Angel. Asuka powers up Eva-02, and decides that she will defeat the Angel by playing "hopscotch"...

9.t: Both of You, Dance Like You Want to Win!
9.o: Asuka joins Shinji’s class at school, and moves in with Misato and him in their apartment. As Asuka adjusts to Japan (or rather, everyone else adapts to her...), a new Angel attacks which is capable of splitting itself into two identical copies. EVA-01 and EVA-02 are defeated, and NERV is publicly humiliated. With the Angel in a week-long regeneration period after an N² Mine attack by the JSSDF, Asuka and Shinji must learn to "synchronize" with each others movements combat, in order to defeat it once and for all.

10.o: The EVA pilots are disappointed to find out that they are not allowed to go on their class trip to Okinawa, because they have to stay at Tokyo-3 to stay on-call in case of an Angel attack. Meanwhile, a new Angel is discovered in a chrysalis-like developmental stage deep within the magma of the volcano Mount Asama.

11.o: Tokyo-3 comes to a standstill when sabotage knocks out all power, and the personnel must scramble to launch the EVAs manually when an Angel appears in the middle of the blackout.

12.t: She said, 'Don't make others suffer for your personal hatred.'
12.o: Misato has been promoted to Major, but the celebration does not last long. A monstrous Angel appears in Earth orbit right when Gendo and Fuyutsuki are away, leaving her and the children to deal with a colossal kamikaze threatening to drop itself right on top of Tokyo-3.

13.o: A routine test involving the EVA pilots turns into a struggle for survival when a wholly new type of Angel appears and spreads inside NERV HQ. This new, computer-like angel threatens to set off the self-destruct for the entire facility, leaving Dr. Ritsuko Akagi in a race against time to save the GeoFront and destroy the Angel.

14.o: In the first half of the episode, a clip show is presented to the Human Instrumentality Committee of Seele, reviewing the attacks of all Angels up to this point. The second part includes a poem in which Rei contemplates her own existence, and a cross-compatibility test between Rei's and Shinji's EVAs.

15.t: Those Women Longed for the Touch of Others' Lips, and Thus Invited Their Kisses.
15.o: It seems like it's an important day for nearly everyone at NERV. Misato and Ritsuko are going to a wedding; Shinji and Gendo are visiting Yui's grave; Asuka has a date. However, important things will spring from these seemingly mundane events.

16.o: Shinji beats Asuka in a synch test, much to her annoyance. Not too long after, the EVAs are dispatched to deal with a mysterious apparition, and EVA-01 is sucked into a shadowlike blackness that materializes out of nothingness from under it. While an emergency operation to rescue the captured EVA is concocted, Shinji goes on a trip into the depths of his own consciousness...

17.o: A NERV branch in Nevada is obliterated in a catastrophic accident, and NERV headquarters prepares to station a new Evangelion in Japan. The Fourth Child is selected, unbeknownst to Shinji.

18.o: Evangelion Unit-03 arrives from the United States. However, its activation experiment brings out NERV's worst nightmare when it turns out to have been infected by the Thirteenth Angel. The other EVAs are dispatched to battle the Angel-infected abomination... even at the risk of killing its helpless pilot.

19.o: Enraged over Touji's near-death at the hands of his own EVA, Shinji refuses to pilot an Evangelion again and prepares to leave Tokyo-3 for good. He is forced to reconsider that decision when an immensely destructive new Angel attacks just as he is about to leave...

20.o: Shinji achieved an unprecedented 400% synchronization ratio with EVA-01 during the battle with Zeruel, to horrible effect. With the EVA having ascended to the status of a living God and Shinji absorbed inside it, Ritsuko unsuccessfully attempts to recover him.

21.t: He Was Aware that He Was Still a Child.
21.o: Kouzou Fuyutsuki is kidnapped and interrogated by Seele, who are horrified over the results of the last encounter with an Angel. He recounts his past, providing flashbacks into the creation of Nerv. The pasts of Misato Katsuragi, Ritsuko Akagi, Rei Ayanami and Yui Ikari are also revealed. Ryouji Kaji, meanwhile, decides to find out the truth, no matter the cost.

22.o: Asuka's synch rate is on a downward spiral after her defeat at the hands of the Fourteenth Angel, Zeruel, and her frustration with Rei, Shinji, Misato and Ryouji is on the rise. Angrier and more disturbed than ever, she is forced to relive her dark, traumatic past during the encounter with the Fifteenth Angel, Arael.

23.o: Asuka sinks into deep depression after Arael's mental probing, and is unable to pilot when the new Angel Armisael arrives. Armisael begins physically fusing with EVA-00 and threatens to do the same to EVA-01, prompting Rei to sacrifice herself to save Shinji, only to appear alive soon afterwards.

24.t: The Beginning and the End, or 'Knockin' on Heaven's Door'
24.o: Too frightened to face Misato or Rei, Shinji runs away yet again, only to meet and strike a friendship with Kaworu Nagisa, the replacement pilot for EVA-02. Kaworu's openness and friendliness provide much-needed comfort for the disturbed Shinji. However, suspicions abound over Kaworu's incredible synchronization abilities.

25.o: Instrumentality has begun, and now its inner process, the joining of all souls into one, will be depicted. The episode is primarily driven by dialogue, the background usually complete darkness. White text often appears on a black screen, an omniscient voice questioning the characters.

26.o: Instrumentality continues. The focus is primarily on Shinji now, as he learns to accept the individual’s ability to shape their world, and how the self cannot exist without others to define it.

1.o: يهرب الشقيقان سيث وريتشـي غيكو نحو المكسيك بعد عملية سطو دامية، لكن توقفهما في متجر خمور يتحول إلى مواجهة مسلحة، بينما تبدأ ريتشي بمطاردة رؤى غامضة.

2.o: يواصل الشقيقان هروبهما بينما يلاحقهما الحارس فريدي غونزاليس، وتزداد رؤى ريتشي غرابة، فيتقاطع طريقهما مع عائلة فولر المتجهة إلى المكسيك.

3.o: يحاول سيث ترتيب عبور الحدود بالتعاون مع كارلوس، بينما تتفاقم رؤى ريتشي وتتعطل عربة عائلة فولر، ويبدأ فريدي في البحث عن تفسير لما يحدث.

4.o: يحتجز سيث وريتشـي عائلة فولر ويستوليان على عربتهم لمواصلة الهروب، لكن وصول فريدي يشعل مواجهة تهدد خطتهم.

5.o: تصل عائلة فولر إلى الحدود داخل العربة، بينما يسيطر الخوف على ريتشي ويحاول جاكوب حماية أبنائه وإيصالهم إلى المكسيك بأمان.

6.o: يدخل غونزاليس المكسيك ويقع في قبضة عصابة المخدرات، بينما يصل آل غيكو وعائلة فولر إلى الحانة التي اتفق سيث مع كارلوس على مقابلته فيها.

7.o: يشاهد غيكو وعائلة فولر عرض سانتانيكو، لكن ظهور فريدي يقلب الأجواء إلى مجزرة، ويكتشف الجميع أن الحانة تخفي سرًا مرعبًا.

8.o: تحاول سانتانيكو استمالة ريتشي، بينما يواجه فريدي كارلوس ويكتشف المزيد عن ماضي المعبد، ويشق سيث وعائلة فولر طريقهم إلى أعماقه.

9.o: يواجه سيث وريتشـي متاهة المعبد، بينما يصطدم جاكوب وكيت بتحول سكوت، ويكتشف فريدي خيطًا جديدًا يقوده إلى الحقيقة.

10.o: يكتشف سيث وريتشـي أنهما تعرضا للخيانة، بينما تواجه عائلة فولر أخطر ما مرّت به، ويتخذ فريدي قرارًا حاسمًا مع اقتراب المواجهة الأخيرة.

1.o: بعد ثلاثة أشهر من تحرير سانتانيكو، يواصل الأخوان غيكو الهروب؛ سيث وكيت في المكسيك، بينما يخطط ريتشي وسانتانيكو للانتقام من سيد الأفعى الذي سجنها.

2.o: يحاول سيث وكيت تنفيذ عملية سطو، بينما تطارد رؤى مرعبة الحارس فريدي غونزاليس، ويؤدي خروج كارلوس من المتاهة إلى تحريك مخططات مالڤادو.

3.t: Attack of the 50 ft. Sex Machine
3.o: يتنكر ريتشي وسانتانيكو كمهربي بشر للتسلل إلى مصدر غذاء مالڤادو، بينما يحاول فريدي مواجهة «آلة الجنس» التي تهدد عائلته.

4.t: The Best Little Horror House In Texas
4.ar: أفضل بيت رعب صغير في تكساس
4.o: تبحث كيت عن شقيقها سكوت قبل أن ينتقم، بينما يجد ريتشي وسانتانيكو نفسيهما وسط تجارة البشر، ويحاول سيث استعادة ثقة عمه إيدي.

5.o: يعلن سيث وريتشـي هدنة ويتعاونان للعثور على مقر مالڤادو، بينما يختطف كارلوس سانتانيكو، وتطلب كيت مساعدة فريدي لإنقاذ شقيقها.

6.o: يتتبع فريدي وكيت آثار مقبرة جماعية، ليكتشفا سرًا خطيرًا ويجدا نفسيهما عالقين في قبو أوكولتو، أحد أسياد الليل الأكثر غموضًا وخطورة.

7.t: Bring Me the Head of Santanico Pandemonium
7.o: يضع سيث وريتشـي، بمساعدة العم إيدي، خطة لمساعدة سانتانيكو على الانتقام، بينما يواجه فريدي وكيت عدوًا غير متوقع.

8.t: The Last Temptation of Richard Gecko
8.o: مع اقتراب تنفيذ العملية الكبرى، يبدأ التحالف الهش بين الأخوين وشركائهما بالانهيار بسبب الخيانات والولاءات الجديدة.

9.o: تواجه سانتانيكو مالڤادو بمساعدة سيث، بينما يحاول ريتشي وكيت منع كارلوس وسكوت من تغيير النبوءة القديمة والسيطرة على شر بالغ القوة.

10.o: يدخل سيث وسانتانيكو في مواجهة مع ريتشي بسبب خيانته، بينما يستعد كارلوس وسكوت للاستيلاء على إمبراطورية مالڤادو وإطلاق فوضى الأفاعي على العالم.

1.o: بعد أن يُخفّض الأخوان غيكو إلى رتبة جامعي الديون، تتسلل إلى منظمتهم قوة غامضة مصممة على تدميرهما وتدمير أسياد الليل وجميع الكوليبرا.

2.o: يطلب سيث وريتشـي مساعدة سانتانيكو، لكنهما يكتشفان أنها أصبحت هدفًا لملكة قديمة من قبائل شيبالبان اتخذت هيئة مألوفة.

3.o: يضطر فريدي غونزاليس إلى التحالف مع عدو قديم لمواجهة شيطان يسعى لاستعباد الكوليبرا، بينما يتعقب سيث وريتشـي صيادًا من العصور القديمة.

4.o: يتعاون فريدي مجددًا مع عدو سابق، بينما يجد الأخوان غيكو نفسيهما في مواجهة محاربي جاكوار الأقوياء.

5.o: يحاول سيث وفريقه حماية مجموعة من المدنيين بعدما يتعرضون لهجمات من آكلي لحوم البشر.

6.o: بعد اختطاف ريتشي على يد أمارو، يستيقظ داخل مصحة مهجورة ويطلب مساعدة سيث، لكن إنقاذه يقود الفريق إلى فخ مرعب.

7.o: يحصل الفريق على فرصة لمواجهة أمارو، لكن الأمور تنقلب عندما يقع أفراده ضحية لإغراءات ورعب شيطانة من شيبالبان.

8.o: تعود سانتانيكو بسر جديد وحليف محتمل، وتقود الأخوين غيكو إلى اللورد فينغانزا المختبئ داخل سجن للكوليبرا.

9.o: يطارد الأخوان غيكو أمارو إلى بلدة غامضة في الغرب، حيث تخطط لاستعادة شكلها الحقيقي وفتح بوابات الجحيم.

10.o: بينما تقترب كيت من الموت، يسابق الأبطال الزمن والكسوف للقضاء على أمارو وإغلاق بوابة شيبالبا قبل أن يبتلع الجحيم العالم.

1.o: The setting is Shibiru City, Yukimachi Town. While most citizens are enjoying the peace and quiet, one young man makes a stand. His name is Hazama Masayoshi.

2.o:
Shibiru City is now home to a superhero named Samurai Flamenco. By pure chance, policeman Goto Hidenori learns the identity of Samurai Flamenco, resulting in numerous headaches as he copes with the new hero's atypical sense of justice. Goto arranges for a meeting to put a stop to all of the trouble, but Masayoshi shows up drenched.

Masayoshi explains that he doesn't use umbrellas because of an incident in his past.

3.o: Samurai Flamenco is receiving more and more views on video sharing sites. Masayoshi is very pleased until a news site begins offering a reward to the person who unmasks Flamenco. That is when another person comes out as Samurai Flamenco. Who is this fake and what is his objective? The battle of Samurai Flamencos is about to begin.

4.o:
After dealing with the imposter, Samurai Flamenco gets to catch his breath, but then he's captured by some lawbreakers he approached.

When all hope appears to be lost, a mysterious new hero appears and saves him. However, the new hero knows Samurai Flamenco's true identity and sees him as a rival. Samurai Flamenco now has a rival superhero. What next?

5.o:
Samurai Flamenco is becoming jaded as Flamenco Girl runs him ragged. The police have been receiving an increasing number of complaints as the heroes wreak havoc.  Masayoshi struggles with his work as it seems that nothing is going right.

Masayoshi begins to wonder what it means to be a hero.

6.o: Flamenco Girl has powered up by recruiting additional Flamenco Girls!  She's enjoying life as she fights evil and performs as an idol.  Meanwhile, Samurai Flamenco is on the run as the citizens have turned against him.

7.o: Masayoshi's efforts have paid off, as Shibiru City has seen a drop in crime.  His acting career is also picking up. Life is looking good, but Masayoshi isn't celebrating.  Instead, he begins to question what he should be doing as a hero.  Troubled, he returns to reading his grandfather's notebook, but it turns out that the story of Samurai Flamenco hides a shocking secret.

8.t: Attack of the Army of Evil!
8.o: A mysterious figure named King Torture has dispatched monsters across Japan.  They demand the unconditional surrender of the Japanese government and the enslavement of the populace.

9.o: The monsters have become part of everyday life. Their attacks are nothing more than a nuisance to the public, leaving Mari wanting more excitement. While the initial excitement has died down, the attention that is still being paid goes to the monsters and Samurai Flamenco.  Unhappy, Mari makes an unexpected move.  Meanwhile, Harazuka has a theory about the monsters' peculiar behavior.

10.t: Final Battle in the Enemy Base!
10.o: Samurai Flamenco heads to the enemy base to save Flamenco Diamond. Flamenco Diamond and Flamenco Sapphire are undergoing torture after being captured.  Diamond tries to protect Sapphire, but King Torture reveals an inconvenient truth. Finally, Samurai Flamenco faces off against King Torture. The true objective of the Evil Army will come to light!

11.o: After King Torture's death, Samurai Flamenco reveals his identify before the press. But in the next moment, Masayoshi is taken away in a aircraft that appears out of nowhere. At the same time, a giant fortress appears in Tokyo Bay. Out of the frying pan and into the fire. What will happen to Samurai Flamenco next?

12.o: Kaname turned out to be the commander of Samurai Base, a counter-secret-organization unit.  Masayoshi is joined by new allies, Soichi, Hekiru, Anji, and Sakura to form the Flamengers who fight to defeat From Beyond.  However, the Flamengers are very different people who struggle to work together.  As their leader, Masayoshi grows worried as monsters continue to attack.

13.o: The Flamengers become the first citizens of Japan to receive the National Hero award as the country places its hope in them.  They are doing well in the battle against From Beyond, but one day, the monsters suddenly vanish.  It seems unlikely that they've given up on taking over Japan.  The Flamengers believe that an all-out attack may be coming and begin to prepare, but they encounter an unexpected obstacle.

14.o: After the press conference, phones begin to ring across Japan. It turns out that the missing monsters of From Beyond are calling to announce their upcoming all-out attack. Little time remains. The Cabinet declares a national emergency and orders the JDF and police into action. After Kaname goes missing, the Flamengers are forced to take lead themselves. From Beyond's attack is about to begin.

15.o: The monster that looks exactly like Masayoshi addresses him as Big Brother and calls himself Beyond Flamenco.  Masayoshi is visibly upset as Beyond Flamenco begins to speak about From Beyond's purpose and objective. At the same time, it appears that the government also has another trick up its sleeve. How will the battle with From Beyond end?

16.o: The government has framed the Flamengers as terrorists who were responsible for the From Beyond attacks. They have also proposed a bill which bans vigilante activities.

17.o: Masayoshi's last hope is Goto. Goto gives him a warm welcome, despite the fact that he is a wanted fugitive. However, they immediately find themselves surrounded.

18.o: With help from the resurrected Flamenco Girls, Masayoshi is able to defeat the Prime Minister. However, the government's true objective wasn't to defeat the superheroes.

19.o: After battling Alien Flamenco and talking to the will of the universe, Masayoshi returns to Earth and finds peace and quiet in a world without evil.  There are no bad guys left, so Masayoshi no longer has anything to do as a superhero.

20.o: The boy named Sawada Haiji has put an end to the temporary peace. He was one of the middle school students that Masayoshi had lectured as Samurai Flamenco.  Haiji declares that he is Masayoshi's last enemy.  He then proceeds to attack the Flamengers, Kaname, and other people who are associated with Masayoshi.

21.o: Masayoshi thinks about taking his own life to stop Haiji. After multiple incidents and an argument with Goto, Masayoshi runs into another wall as he attempts to track down Haiji. Goto is also in a difficult position. That is when Haiji makes his next move.

22.o: A gunshot rings through the night. Masayoshi races to find Goto who has been captured by Haiji.  Masayoshi wanted to be a hero. Goto wanted to hold onto his girlfriend.

1.o: The introverted Yuu Haruna has moved to Tokyo to live with this three sisters after their parents left to work abroad. While passing through the local shopping district, Yuu's eyes are riveted on a TV screen in a store window when a girl comes running up the street and crashes into him. That is how he met the girl who seemed to be wrapped in a summer breeze: Fuuka Akitsuki. Their first meeting goes downhill when Fuuka mistakes Yuu's intentions with the smartphone in his hand, and on top of that, he then finds out that they'll be in the same class at his new school...

2.o: Yuu ends up on pool-cleaning duty with fellow classmates Fuuka and Mikasa, who seem like more than just friends. Meanwhile, Koyuki Hinashi, a popular singer who was childhood friends with Yuu, calls him for the first time in years.

3.o: Yuu and Mikasa are dragged into Fuuka's plan to form a band after Yuu unwittingly gives her the idea, and the three of them start a light music association. In order to earn money to afford their instruments they decide to stay at a beach house over the summer and work part-time. But the personality of the owner, Yahagi, rubs Yuu the wrong way.

4.o: Yuu's late night meeting with Koyuki causes misunderstandings between him and Fuuka. Yuu's attempt to make up fails, and the mood remains awkward between them at work. Meanwhile their teacher, Tomomi, shows up at the beach house with the track team captain, Nachi, and reveals something unexpected.

5.o: The new school term has begun, and Yuu's band has begun to practice in earnest, but bassist Yuu and vocalist/guitarist Fuuka are complete beginners. Nachi isn't much better as a drummer, and they attempt to recruit a senpai from their school, Sara Iwami, to take over on guitar. She's cold to them at first, but a revelation about Yuu brings her around.

6.o: Memories of childhood, parting, and regret cause Koyuki to make up her mind to face Yuu. She visits his home to give him concert tickets, but the two of them had no idea that this meeting would have immense consequences... On her way home, Koyuki runs into Fuuka, a huge fan of the singer, and the two end up at a public bathhouse together, much to Fuuka's delight.

7.o: A photo of Yuu and Koyuki taken outside his home spreads like wildfire on Twitter, creating a huge scandal for the popular singer. Even Yuu's account is found and targeted, and wild rumors are going around at school. The band's practices in preparation for the school fair had been coming along smoothly, but the rumors spoil Fuuka's mood. Meanwhile, Koyuki addresses the controversy on national television with a surprising declaration.

8.o: The day of the school fair has arrived. Fans enraged by Yuu and Koyuki's scandal crowd around and shout abuse as their band takes the stage. Yuu is certain that the power of Fuuka's singing can silence them, but chaos breaks loose. Koyuki, who had come to see Yuu's concert in secret, can't stand silently by any longer.

9.o: For their first date, Yuu and Koyuki meet to visit a small town that she once visited when filming for a variety show. Meanwhile Yuu's band, The Fallen Moon, has been selected as an opening act for a gig at a live music club. Fuuka suggests they write an original song to play there, but a strange sense of confusion in her heart makes the process difficult.

10.o: Fuuka continues to struggle with the lyrics for the band's original song. A concerned Mikasa tries to reach out, but Fuuka is unable to verbalize her true feelings. Yuu also becomes worried and calls her, but his kindness only makes her feel worse. With their first gig only days away, what feelings will Fuuka express in her lyrics?

11.o: Fuuka's sudden decision to quit the band and go solo shook the members of The Fallen Moon. They had successfully completed their first gig and were determined to make their own legend, but they can't be a band without a vocalist. Despite their lingering regrets, Sara, Mikasa, and Nachi set off to walk their own path.

12.o: Yuu writes an original song in an attempt to bring Fuuka back to the band, but she avoids him completely. Now, as their growing popularity online has earned the attention of the HEDGEHOGS members, they've been invited to play at a live club again. The members have no choice but to practice their new song with no vocalist, but Yuu still isn't willing to give up.

Desperate to keep his buddies from watching the fight at a neighbor's house, Frank promises an epic big-screen experience. But now he has to deliver.

2.o: Frank's attempt to teach Kevin a lesson about respect yields unintended results.  Maureen makes babysitting a nightmare for Bill.  Sue finds out selling Plast-a-Ware isn't as fulfilling as she'd like.

3.o: Frank makes a powerful friend at a football game and his move into management stirs up trouble with his old work pals.

4.o: Halloween is all tricks and no treats as Frank secretly torpedoes Sue's shot at a real job and a bully leaves Bill afraid to don his costume.

5.o: Bill's surprise attack on the neighborhood bully backfires in a big way. Frank has to swallow his pride to make good on a promise to Kevin.

6.o: Christmas Eve turns chaotic as Frank's deal to avoid a strike hits a last-minute snag and Bill's first stint as an altar boy leads to trouble.

1.o: As Frank stews over his lost job, Sue tries to lighten the mood with a family sledding trip. But the outing brings on more headaches.

2.o: Frank's big meeting doesn't play out quite like expected. Fed up with plasticware parties, Sue begins to fantastize about a change.

3.o: Sue discovers a major downside of office life, Frank sucks it up for a trip to the unemployment line, and Kevin finally gets a space of his own.

4.o: As Frank scrambles to prove himself at a new job, Kevin and his band plot to get their song on the radio. Sue has a Plast-a-Ware brainstorm.

5.o: Kevin's dreams of rock stardom stir up trouble at home. A setback the day before hockey tryouts pushes Bill over the edge. Sue gives her big pitch.

6.o: Frank's job takes him back to the airport, with awkward results. Kevin prepares for his date with "haircut girl". Bill revels in his new outlaw ways.

7.o: Sue meets with the queen of Plast-a-Ware and plans a romantic night out with Frank. But a call from Maureen's school triggers a family meltdown.

8.o: As Sue and Frank try to hash things out, Kevin is wracked with guilt over the incident at Vic's. Bill comes face to face with his old nemesis.

9.o: A couple's retreat leads to a moment of truth for Frank and Sue. Bill and Phillip hatch a plan to deal with Jimmy. Suprises abound at Vic's party.

10.o: Sue gears up for her big moment at the shareholders' meeting, while Frank and friends lay a trap for Scoop. But the day takes a dramatic turn.

1.t: Are You Ready for the Summer?
1.o: The Murphys kick off summer with a trip to the town Memorial Day parade, where bottled-up frustrations and fears about the new baby boil over.

2.o: Sue's hopes of a romantic night with Frank at the drive-in are dashed when he brings the new neighbors along. Kevin's bandmates drop a bombshell.

3.o: Sue dreams up a new invention, Kevin starts summer school, Bill suffers an awkward mishap at the pool, and a promotion stokes tensions at the airport.

4.o: As the guys start work on the baby's room, Chet takes Frank on an unforgettable outing to the Air Force base. A jealous Phillip lashes out at Bill.

5.o: While Sue hosts a soul-crushing focus group for the Forkoontula, Frank tries to keep Vic from bonding with Chet, and Bill sneaks out with Bridget.

6.o: Frank can't wait to party with his new best bud on the Fourth of July, but rising tensions between Chet and Sue set off the wrong kind of fireworks.

Rusty tries to mediate the situation to save his friendship with Calvin but finds it only escalates the rivalry. Meanwhile, Casey learns that the only way to rid ZBZ of Lizzi, the conservative national rep overseeing them, is to forgive Frannie and reinstate her in a "diamond" ceremony.

Yeo Mi-ran’s distaste for petty, philandering men grows even stronger. Nam Kang-ho offends his finicky co-star on the set of their drama.

3.t: Nice Guys Get a Pass Bad Boys Have It Coming

4.t: You Are Not What I Expected

8.o: When Mi-ran gets hurt, Kang-ho realizes his feelings for her are deeper than he imagined. Won-jun and Shin Na-eun flirt with teaming up — and each other.

9.t: You Made Me Who I Am

10.o: News of Mi-ran's dating history gets out, making her a social pariah. Will she and Kang-ho give in to pressure and break up, or will love prevail?

1.o: An enigmatic mother and daughter check into a luxury hotel, but despite their efforts to lay low, they spark curiosity among the staff and guests.

2.o: Faced with her daughter’s difficult questions, the mother relives bittersweet memories. The duo spend a day separately – and in distress.

3.o: With the police on their trail, the mother and daughter remember their promise to each other. The daughter overhears a disturbing conversation.

4.o: The mother recalls her conflicted emotions after giving birth and devises a plan to evade the police as she and her daughter prepare for a long trip.

5.o: A visit to the bank ends in a bold escape. A relative talks to the police about the mother’s past. Broke and desperate, the mother ponders a solution.

6.o: The duo avoids a trap. As the mother confronts her father, the daughter commits a shocking act. Damning evidence emerges at several murder scenes.

7.o: The mother tries another way to get money. With the police closing in on them, the duo flees once again in what could be their final attempt to run.

1.o: After calling off the invasion of Earth, Ned and Cornelius decide to start a late-night talk show and beam in Andy Richter and Gillian Jacobs to be their first guests. BETI convinces Ned to fire the CLODs on their first day as his house band.

2.o: When the CLODs start getting more fan mail than he does, Ned beams in comedians Kristen Schaal and Paul Scheer to help him understand human comedy. Cornelius is beamed to the surface and tries to master standup comedy. BETI starts a podcast.

3.t: I've Got a Ned Feeling About This
3.o: When Ned becomes obsessed with Star Wars, he beams in super fan Reggie Watts and the legendary Billy Dee Williams. The CLODs start a lightsaber battle. BETI asks BB-8 to help repair the Roaster Toaster. Ned reaches out to his father, the Admiral.

4.o: When the CLODs stay up late watching scary movies, Ned learns about horror from Lil Rel Howery and director Eli Roth. Cornelius is sent to investigate a human cemetery. BETI warns the ship may be haunted. The full moon leads to a terrifying transformation.

5.o: Wildlife experts Bindi & Robert Irwin and comedian Jenny Slate try to help Ned understand why humans adopt pets. Cornelius sneaks a pet onboard the ship and ends up experiencing a day of beauty at a dog grooming salon. Ned’s new pet is a surprise.

6.o: Ned tries to “win” social media with help from NeNe Leakes and Michael Ian Black. Cornelius learns social media secrets from the experts: teenagers.

7.o: Ned beams in Raven Symone and comedian Thomas Lennon, hoping they can help him understand human art. BETI takes aim at Lennon with a brain beam. Cornelius becomes a street artist.

8.o: Baffled by football, Ned drafts Joel McHale and Gina Carano to help him understand human sports. Cornelius is beamed to a wrestling school and discovers his alter-ego “Corndog Jackson.”

9.o: Ned becomes a fashionista with help from Rachel Bilson and RuPaul Charles. Cornelius beams to the surface and becomes a stylist. The CLODs stage a fashion show in honor of RuPaul’s favorite fashion icon, Cher.

10.o: Mesmerized by musicals, Ned gets Taye Diggs and Rachel Bloom to help him create his own musical episode. High School Musical: The Musical: The Series stars Olivia Rodrigo and Joshua Bassett inspire Cornelius to find his voice. BETI and the CLODs stage a production number.

11.t: Dream a little Dream of Ned
11.o: After Ned dreams for the first time, Ginnifer Goodwin and Alan Tudyk help him separate dreams from reality. BETI’s brain scanner exposes the crew’s secret dreams. Cornelius sees a therapist.

12.o: Obsessed with winning an award, Ned hosts his own awards show, with D’Arcy Carden and Oliver Hudson. Cornelius is beamed to the surface to take an acting class. The CLODs make a Western.

13.o: When Ned gets stressed out, Yvette Nicole Brown and Jack McBrayer try to teach him how to relax. Cornelius is beamed to a “rage room.” Ned is troubled by a message from his home planet.

14.t: Party Like It’s Nineteen Ninety Ned
14.o: Actor/director Kevin Smith and actress Aisha Tyler help Ned indulge his 90’s obsession. Cornelius is sent to the future and discovers comedian Ben Schwartz is starring in a reboot of Ned’s talk show. The CLODs stage a 90’s-themed fashion show.

15.o: When Ned hears aliens may have built the pyramids, he investigates human conspiracy theories with Sherri Shepherd and Penn & Teller. Cornelius goes undercover as a human to find out what Earthlings really think about aliens.

16.o: Sitcom stars Alyson Hannigan & Ben Feldman help Ned cope with love. Cornelius tries speed dating. The CLODs create a fake dating profile.

17.o: After Ned catches Cornelius snacking after bedtime, Chef Roy Choi and Brenda Song help him become a foodie. The CLODs open their own restaurant, with disgusting results.

18.o: When BETI crashes, Ned’s interviews with Mayim Bialik and Margaret Cho are disrupted by glitches and blue ooze. Cornelius is trapped at the Intergalactic Whiz Desk.

19.o: When one of Ned’s CLODs runs away, Molly Ringwald and Chris Colfer try to explain “growing up.” Cornelius goes in search of the missing CLOD, and unexpectedly meets Grace VanderWaal.

20.o: With Ned’s dad on his way to Earth, Jason Ritter and Tig Notaro try to help prove humanity should be saved, and teach Ned about the true meaning of family. Cornelius makes a decision that may change his life. The secret origin of the CLODs is revealed.

1.o: After Brian Nightraider gets fired from the police, he gets a letter from the United Nation Immigration Bureau Special Task Force, "Marginal Service." He visits the address in the letter, only to find a bizarre occult shop.

2.t: One Step and Riddled With Bullets
2.o: Still on the fence about Borderlanders, Brian goes on a mission to find out the truth. In a red costume, he accompanies Zeno, Robin, and Bolts to Jukai, where the drug factory is supposed to be. On their way, their chopper gets shot down by a missile.

3.o: Brian and the team attempt to infiltrate Rubber Suit's mansion while he's holding a charity auction, hoping to retrieve a rare item being used to manufacture illegal drugs.

4.o: The team tries to crack a mysterious case involving terrorist bombings that seem to be following a clear pattern, but not a clear purpose.

5.t: Sexy Santa Lights the Holy Night
5.o: On Christmas morning, Brian wakes up to a cyberattack to the Marginal Service, which escalates from embarrassing photos to possible data leakage about the Marginal Service and Borderlanders. Lyra has a good idea of who’s responsible.

6.t: Boobs for a Marmot, Air Tank for a Shark
6.o: The Marginal Service finds out that Rubber escaped to Higashino Island. They have to get there on a boat, but Cyrus isn't happy about it since he hates nature. Brian happily suggests a fishing contest. But what he manages to catch is a shark.

7.t: Making Up Is the Beginning of Another Fight
7.o: Brian and Zeno set out to rescue Robin and Bolts, who have fallen into Rubber Suit's clutches. Little do they know that Robin and Bolts are about to discover a secret about their past that will completely upend the mission.

8.o: The Marginal Service goes to the holding facility converted from a mall, where Rubber is being transferred. After Cyrus conducts a medical check up on Rubber, something strange starts to happen.

9.t: An Ounce of Energy Drink Is Worth a Pound of Cure
9.o: Rubber is in custody with the higher ups at the UN. Zeno is upset that he can't interrogate Rubber, and suspects that Theodore's hiding something. Zeno collapses and wakes up in Cyrus's lab, and everything starts to look shady.

10.o: Zeno gets caught up in the investigation of a missing child, but Brian worries that Zeno may end up going too far due to his troubled past.

12.o: Having heard the truth from Rubber, Brian is reunited with Zeno in Mt. Minakami and suggests to rescue children together, but Zeno doesn't listen. While they fight, the doomsday for the Earth, another Gray Shock is about to happen.

1.o: Moo-young has only been taking cases of high-profile clients due to his health condition. But he can no longer suppress the passion in him, so he decides to take the Geumseong murder case. Thanks to him, Ro-um gets exonerated. After being released from prison, Ro-um quickly finds a way to make money using her photographic memory.

2.o: Moo-young learns that Ro-um was one of the kids sponsored by the Jeokmok Foundation. He learns the history of how Ro-um grew up and why she had to confess that she killed her parents. Meanwhile, Ro-um calls her old friends to carry out the plan she has been planning all her life.

3.o: Ro-um catches a man trying to capture her photos and finds out how he's been taking photos of random women secretly. When Moo-young comes to help her, Ro-um suggests unlawful ways to punish him. Meanwhile, Moo-young looks for ways to help Ms. Seo, who lost her son after she gave him up for adoption.

4.o: Ro-um uses all the ways to win Myung-hoon's insurance money that is worth 400 million won. Yo-han pays a surprise visit at Moo-young's place, and Moo-young covers up for Ro-um who was hiding there. Meanwhile, Ringgo gets kidnapped by a voice phishing ring, and Ro-um comes up with a way to save Ringgo.

5.o: After finding out about Jeokmok Kids, Moo-young declares to Ro-um that he'll help with her fraud. The Jeokmok Kids come together as a whole after Nasa joins them. They begin a new operation, and they use Moo-young as their frontman. Ro-um is determined to show him the difference between a con artist and a lawyer.

6.o: Ro-um calls the police on Moo-young, setting him in a trap. But Moo-young quickly thinks of a way to make his way out of the situation. Meanwhile, Ye Chung-sik gets killed in his cell, and the killer names Ro-um as his instigator.

7.o: Ro-um reveals to Moo-young what happened between her and Director An ten years ago. To obtain the notebook containing the identity of the president, Ro-um and her team disguise themselves and break into the hotel vault. Moo-young requests to meet Jang Kyung-ja in person to hack into her phone.

8.o: Ro-um and the gang carry out the operation as planned, but a series of unexpected events occur. Yo-han finds out that his mother was an advisor for Jeokmok Foundation and confronts her. Moo-young realizes who was behind his father's company's fraud case that destroyed his family.

9.t: Truth Behind Jeokmok and Navis Well-being
9.o: Moo-young calls Prosecutor Ryu and Reporter Woo to help dig into Jeokmok Foundation and Navis Well-being. Ma Kang-soo, the CEO of Darusa International, gets out of prison, which puts Jang Kyung-ja in a pickle. Jae-in learns that the subjects she studied in college were none other than the Jeokmok Kids themselves.

10.o: Moo-young decides to map the whole organization, and Ro-um uses her eidetic memory to recall the contents of the ledger. The Jeokmok Kids join hands with Prosecutor Ryu and Reporter Woo to bring Jeokmok down. Meanwhile, Moo-young hears the news about his father.

11.o: Ro-um and her team try to get their hands on Kang-soo's plan for his stock price manipulation. Yeon Tae-hoon gets on Kang-soo's nerves and gets fired. Kang-soo demands a copy of the notebook from Kyung-ja. Meanwhile, Moo-young demands Ro-um to tell him why she wants Jay on their team.

12.o: Yo-han and Jae-in disguise themselves as a couple and attend Min Kang-yoon's party. Ringgo also attends the party with fake identification, but he fails to capture her attention. Instead, Kang-yoon shows interest in Ro-um. Meanwhile, Kang-soo manages to get the money for his investment, but something unexpected happens at the investment briefing.

13.o: Da-jung's server gets hacked, and they lose all the data they stole from Navis. The crew thinks it's the president's doing. Moo-young suggests a class action lawsuit, which can have the prosecution search and seize Navis' properties. But this plan doesn't go well, so they decide to commit fraud again.

14.o: Moo-young learns what his father did to earn the money for his tuition. Su-ho sees the photo Ringgo sent and realizes who the president is. Ro-um receives a gift from Jay, which leaves her staggered. Then she realizes that the only way to end everything is to get rid of the president herself.

15.o: Ro-um gets arrested as the prime suspect of Jang Kyung-ja's murder. Moo-young comes up with a plan to get Ro-um out of the prosecutors' office and protect Da-jung, Su-ho, and Ringgo at the same time. Meanwhile, the truth behind Jang Kyung-ja's death gets revealed.

16.o: Da-jung collects all the evidence against Jay and organizes them so they can be used against him. Ro-um faces Jay head-to-head and demands he return the money he made through Navis. The Jeokmok Kids end up in court pleading guilty to their crimes.

1.o: تُعاني شهيرة من الغرور الزائد بعد تدليل أهلها لها، يقرر أصحاب شهيرة الانتقام منها من خلال اتفاقهم مع شاب على محاولة كسب قلبها وجعلها مُغرمة به فتنجح خطتهم وتنهار شهيرة في النهاية بعدما تعلم الحقيقة

2.o: تواجه نهى ملل شديد خاصة بعد فشل زواجها 4 مرات، تقابل نهى - طارق وتُعجب به ويتزوجها وبعدها تشعر بالملل أيضًا وتطلب الانفصال عنه وترفض والدتها وتقرر في النهاية تقبل الأمر الواقع.

3.o: يتشاجر محمد مع شقيقته زينب بشكل مستمر ويُبرحها ضربًا مؤلمًا، تقرر زينب التخلص من الأمر بالموافقة على الزواج من أول شخص يتقدم لها الذي تكتشف بعد الزواج أنه أسوء من شقيقها.

4.o: تُغرم ماهيتاب بالدكتور هاني الذي يُدرس لها في الجامعة، يتزوج هاني - ماهيتاب، يكتشف هاني أن زوجته مُدللة أكثر من اللازم فيهجرها، تقرر ماهيتاب تغيير طريقة حياتها بعدما تتعايش مع مجموعة من الناس الفقراء داخل منازلهم.

5.o: تنهار زهيرة بعدما يهجرها عريسها ليلة الزفاف، يقرر زاهر والد زهيرة إدخال ابنته مصحة نفسية وتُعالج على يد طبيب يُدعى صبري الذي يُعجب بها مع الوقت ويطلب يدها للزواج.

6.o: يتزوج فهد من وردة خاصة بعد إعجابها الشديد ببطولاته الرياضية في الملاكمة، ينهار مستوى فهد بعد الزواج فتقرر وردة تحميل زوجها كل أمور المنزل، تتشاجر وردة مع فهد وتطلب منها والدتها الحفاظ على بيتها وزوجها.

7.o: يعاني رجب من زوجته فوزية التي تقرر في كل مرة ترك المنزل والذهاب إلى والدتها فيقرر تطليقها، تقرر فوزية الانتقام من زوجها وتخبر الناس أنه لا يستطيع الإنجاب.

8.o: تُغرم أحلام بملحن شهير يُدعى حازم، تساعد نعيمة صديقتها أحلام وتحصل على ميعاد لكي تقابل فتى أحلامها حازم، تحاول أحلام جذب انتباه حازم بشتى الطرق حتى يقع في شباكها دون جدوى منه.

9.o: يتشاجر عليوة بشكل يومي مع زوجته إنشراح بسبب ظروف حياتهما المادية والمعيشية، يستمع عليوة إلى نصائح عبدالجبار الذي يطلب من الرجال عدم الاهتمام بأي شيء يزعجهم وأن يتركوا كل شيء سلبي خلفهم.

10.o: يتزوج عماد من رقية زواج صالونات ويتشاجر معها بشكل يومي بسبب عدم وجود صيغة تفاهم مشتركة بينهما، يكتشف عماد أن زوجته كانت مُغرمة بشخصا آخر قبل الزواج منها وتكتشف هي الأخرى أن زوجها كان مُغرم بفتاة وتصبح حياتهما جحيم.

11.o: يتزوج عماد من رقية زواج صالونات ويتشاجر معها بشكل يومي بسبب عدم وجود صيغة تفاهم مشتركة بينهما، يكتشف عماد أن زوجته كانت مُغرمة بشخصا آخر قبل الزواج منها وتكتشف هي الأخرى أن زوجها كان مُغرم بفتاة وتصبح حياتهما جحيم.

12.o: يحكي غنيم لصديقه حاتم قصة ساحر صيني اكتشف خيانة زوجته له بعدما غاب عنها وبين للجميع أنه توفى، يقرر حاتم إعطاء زوجته هدية عبارة عن مروحة بعدما يتأكد من وفائها وإخلاصها له.

13.o: يتهم إسماعيل وبهية بإهمالها لأبنائهما، تلقي الشرطة القبض على ابنهما يحيى وهو يُعطي صديقه أفلاما مُخلة.

14.o: يحاول أبو النجا فرض سيطرته المطلقة على زوجته منال بعد زواجها رغمًا عنها، يجن جنون منال من معاملة أبو النجا لها فتقرر الرحيل عن المنزل دون عودة.

15.o: يتشاجر عبودة وألفت بشكل مستمر، يعزم عبودة وألفت صديقه عبدالعال وزوجته هويدا في منزلهما، يُعرف عبودة - هاني على ألفت الذي ينظر لزوجته ألفت بطريقة غير أخلاقية ولكنها ترفض الأمر وتطلب من هاني أن يخرج من حياة زوجها وحياتها.

1.o: بعد أن تهرب خادمة أبي صامل وأم صامل من المنزل، تطلب الأخيرة من زوجها مساعدتها في تحضير السمبوسة، الأمر الذي يعطي نجر فرصة لا تعوض للتهكم والاستهزاء.

2.o: بعد أن تهرب خادمة أبي صامل وأم صامل من المنزل، تطلب الأخيرة من زوجها مساعدتها في تحضير السمبوسة، الأمر الذي يعطي نجر فرصة لا تعوض للتهكم والاستهزاء.

3.o: بعد إلحاح من زوجته وابنه، يقوم أبو صامل بعمل الحجز اللازم لتناول الإفطار في أحد الفنادق الفخمة، إلا أن وصول بعض الأقارب يضع خطة العائلة في خطر.

4.o: تسمع أم صامل زوجها يتغنى غزلا بفتاة اسمها سارة، ويصر الأخير أنها مجرد أغنية، فتستعين بصديقتها في محاولة للوصول إلى لب الأمر.

5.o: يحاول أبو صامل مكرها التعامل مع شقيق زوجته الذي قدم إلى الرياض بحثا عن عمل، وقرر المكوث في بيت أخته أم صامل.

6.o: يقوم أبو صامل بدعوة شقيقة جاره للدخول إلى منزل عائلته مساعدة لها، ليكتشف أن أهل البيت في الخارج، فيقرر عدم البقاء داخل المنزل مع الفتاة، ولكن أم صامل تظهر على عتبة الباب.

7.o: في محاولة منه لاختبار شهامة وحمية من حوله، يشيع أبو صامل بينهم أنه غارق في الدين، ليتبين له الصديق الحقيقي من المتصنع.

8.o: يلاحظ أبو صامل غرابة تصرفات أم صامل بعد أن تبدأ ممارسة اليوجا ويطلب النصح من نجر، الذي يعتقد أنها مصابة بما يدعى مرض الطاقة.

9.o: يقرر صامل دعوة أصدقائه لتناول إفطار رمضاني في منزله، فينقلب المكان رأسا على عقب عندما يتحمس والده للفكرة ويأمر بتجهيز عدد من الذبائح.

10.o: يصل رجل أوروبي وزوجته تائهين إلى مخيم أبي صامل في الصحراء، فيقرر الأخير دعوتهما إلى منزله للاحتفاء بهما، إلا أن أم صامل تشك أنهما سرقا طوقا من الذهب يخصها.

11.o: تصل ابنة خال أم صامل إلى المدينة ولديها أخبار عن ناقة ينوي أبو صامل شرائها، فيتعجب الأخير من ذكائها وخبرتها، الأمر الذي لا تستقبله زوجته بصدر رحب.

12.o: بعد أن تشعر بتقصير زوجها في أداء واجباته نحو المنزل والعائلة وتعجز في جعله يغير عادته، تقرر أم صامل أخذ الأمور على عاتقها، وتقوم بحضور اجتماع مجلس الآباء في مدرسة صامل بنفسها.

13.ar: ما يغسل الترند إلا ترند ثاني
13.o: أثناء محاولة إرسال صور حليها الجديدة لصديقتها، تقوم أم صامل عن طريق الخطأ بمشاركة مقطع مصور لها على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، فيهب الجميع لمحاولة حذفه لكن دون جدوى.

14.o: تقع أم صامل في حيرة من أمرها عندما تكتشف أن أبا صامل قام بشراء طقم من الذهب دون مناسبة قريبة تستدعي الهدايا، وتشك أنه ينوي الزواج من أخرى.

15.o: يتعرض كل من أبي صامل وزوجته لمواقف مؤسفة يعتقدان أن السبب وراءها هو حسد نجر وزوجته لهما، فيقرران أخذ الأمور على عاتقهما للتخلص من المشكلة.

16.o: يوافق أبو صامل على دراسة ابنه في لندن وسكنه مع عائلة إنجليزية لتعلم اللغة، ولكن بشرط، أن يرافقه هو وأم صامل!

17.o: يقرر أبو صامل الدخول إلى عالم العملات الرقمية مدفوعا بطمعه في تحقيق أرباح طائلة في وقت قصير، ولكن هل سيكون كل ما يلمع ذهبا هذه المرة؟

18.o: تقرر أم صامل أن تحتفل مع أبي صامل بعيد زواجهما وتقوم بتجهيز الأمر من الألف إلى الياء، إلا أن وصول ضيف يطلب الاختباء في منزلهما يضرب بخطتهما عرض الحائط.

19.o: ينتشر مقطع مصور لإحدى الفاشنيستات تتباهى من خلاله بتلقيها ناقة كهدية من أحد ملاك الإبل، فتحوم الشكوك حول أبي صامل، وتقرر زوجته الوصول إلى الحقيقة بنفسها.

20.o: ينهمك أبو صامل في دخول جولات تحدي على تطبيق تيك توك، فيشعر نجر بالاستياء ويتهمه بالسعي وراء المال، إلا أن جرمان يفعل كل ما بوسعه لدعم الأول وجعله ينتصر.

21.o: تتصل الإعلامية جوجو بأبي صامل وتطلب لقاءه لموضوع مهم خاص بها فيستقبلها في بيته، إلا أن أم صامل تكتشف وجود الضيفة غير المرغوب بها فتقتحم المجلس.

22.o: بعد أن تتلقى دعوة لإقامة أمسية شعرية، تستعين أم صامل بزوجها ليكتب لها قصائد الأمسية، وبسبب انشغال الأخير، يلجأ بدوره لنجر كي ينجز له المهمة.

23.o: مع اقتراب العيد، تتعرض عائلة أبي صامل للعديد من المواقف المحرجة التي هم في غنى عنها.

24.o: تشتري أم صامل خيزرانة لاستخدامها خلال حفلات الزفاف، فيعيش أبو صامل جميع أنواع الرعب معتقدا أنه سيذوق لسعة العصا الجديدة.

25.o: بينما يصطحب أبو صامل ابنه إلى حظيرة الإبل لاكتساب الخبرة والتعلم، يصل اثنين من أبناء عم الأول ضيوفا إلى منزله، فتتكفل أم صامل بالأمر وتحضر لهما بنفسها وليمة للعشاء.

26.o: بعد الفشل المتكرر لنادي المطانيخ التابع للقرية وفي محاولة لتصحيح أوضاعه، يلجأ لاعبو النادي إلى أبي صامل، الذي تعجب قراراته الجديدة زوجته وابنه، ولكن ليس الفريق!

27.o: بعد أن يؤجر أبو محمد جزءا من منزله ويدخل المستأجر الجديد في جدل كبير مع الأول وأبي صامل، يحاول الجميع إيجاد حل لمشكلة الخصوصية التي بات منزل أبي صامل يفتقر إليها.

28.o: عندما تخبر وضحى أم صامل أنها لجأت إلى الطب الشعبي رغبة في الإنجاب، تقرر الأخيرة السفر مع زوجها إلى سويسرا بحثا عن معالجة شعبية هناك.

29.o: عندما يظهر أحد معارفه القدماء ذو السمعة السيئة دون سابق إنذار، يقرر أبو صامل الاختباء وعدم الخروج من المنزل تجنبا لأي مواجهات.

30.o: مشاهد لم تروها سابقا من وراء كواليس مسلسل جاك العلم

1.o: في "الصومال" عام 1993، تنقلب الجهود الرامية لإنهاء المجاعة والحرب الأهلية إلى أعمال عنف ومأساة دامية حين تسفر مهمة أمريكية للإطاحة بزعيم متمرد عن مقتل العديد من المدنيين.

2.o: تنقلب غارة اعتيادية لاعتقال اثنين من معاوني "عيديد" إلى عملية إنقاذ فوضوية عندما تصطدم قوات "الرينجرز" بمقاومة صومالية شرسة.

3.o: في الوقت الذي تثير فيه أنباء فشل عملية "بلاك هوك" اضطرابًا في الولايات المتحدة، ينتشر فيديو لطيار أسير يصدم العالم بأسره. فهل سيتم إنقاذه؟

1.o: يستيقظ سكان منطقة السليمية في إسطنبول على انفجار مدمر بعد تفجير ناقلة النفط اندبنديتا في أواخر عام 1979.

2.o: يحاول علي العودة للحياة العادية بعد تعرض ممتلكاته للتخريب من خلال إصلاح نوافذ الحي المكسورة. يخطط أوغوز لإيجاد منزل دائم لإلميرا.

3.o: يبحث جاكسون عن أدلة للعثور على المهاجم الذي صوب المسدس على رأس شقيقه. يتحد الحي بأكمله لدفع تكاليف العملية الجراحية لنافع الذي أصيب في عينيه أثناء الانفجار.

4.o: يُخرِج علي أرجان من الحبس بكفالة على خلفية بيعه للأسماك الفاسدة، لكن هذا الموقف لا يجعل أرجان يتراجع عن طموحه. تأتي الشرطة لمنزل السيدة ماريكا، فتهرب ألميرا.

5.o: يقع أركان في مشكلة كبيرة عندما يطرد الصيادون، وتجد ياسمين السلوى في أدوية والدتها عندما ترى أيوب مع امرأة أخرى.

6.o: يتلقى أيوب رسالة من المنظمة تطلب فيها قتل شخص آخر. يتلقى إرجان عرضاً محفوفاً بالمخاطر ولكنه مربح من اثنين من الغواصين.

7.o: ترسل إلميرا رسالة إلى جهات الاتصال الخاصة بها في إيطاليا لقناعتها بضرورة مغادرة تركيا. يعرض سامي على علي فرصة العمل في مناقصة حكومية بمدينة يوزغات.

8.o: يتم الكشف عن هوية إلميرا بعد نزول الشرطة السرية إلى الحي والتحقيق معها. تؤدي أعمال علي الصالحة أخيراً إلى نتائج مثمرة ويجري نافع العملية الجراحية ليرى الدمار الذي نجم عن الانفجار.
